text: おかえりなさい　たいへん　だったわね　すこし　やすんで　いったら　どうかしら…？

structure.jp: たいへん　だったわね
すこし　やすんで　いったら
structure.en: if you rested a little before going

patterns.name: 〜たらどう
patterns.span: いったら　どうかしら
patterns.explanation: たら plus どう is a gentle way to suggest something, like 'why don't you'. かしら is a soft, feminine 'I wonder'. いったら　どうかしら = 'why not go after that, I wonder?'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: やすんで　いったら
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いく means doing something first and then going on your way. やすんで　いったら = 'if you rest and then go'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives a soft, feminine tone, here from Mom; ね adds 'wasn't it'. だったわね = 'it was, wasn't it'.
